title: English Practice Quiz 0935
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Service recovery refers to actions taken after ___.
options: a service failure or customer problem
questions.explanation: Service recovery aims to address a failure and restore customer confidence.

questions.question: When a customer reports a delay, first acknowledge ___.
options: that the customer is always wrong
questions.explanation: Acknowledging the inconvenience shows that the concern has been heard.

questions.question: A realistic service recovery promise should be ___.
questions.explanation: Promises should be accurate and within the employee's authority.

questions.question: After resolving a complaint, follow-up can help confirm ___.
questions.explanation: Follow-up checks whether the customer considers the issue resolved.

questions.question: A root cause of repeated service delays might be ___.
questions.explanation: A process issue can create recurring delays.

questions.question: If a complaint is outside your authority, you should ___.
options: refer it to the appropriate person and explain the next step
questions.explanation: Appropriate referral ensures the concern reaches someone who can act.

questions.question: A service apology should be ___.
options: sincere and specific about the inconvenience
conditional on the customer being silent
questions.explanation: A sincere apology recognises the customer's experience.

questions.question: Recording complaint trends helps an organisation ___.
questions.explanation: Trend analysis can reveal issues that need broader improvement.

questions.question: A customer should be updated when a promised resolution is delayed because ___.
questions.explanation: Timely updates help maintain trust when circumstances change.

questions.question: A fair complaint process should treat similar cases ___.
questions.explanation: Consistency supports fairness while allowing relevant circumstances to be considered.
